summary.text: 31 leases in August at $400 average cost per lease. 79.1% leased, with 31 signed residents moving in. Next month we're aligning Google Ads conversion tracking with CRM leads and building lease-up ad variants from the existing photo library.

occupancy.label: Occupancy
occupancy.takeaway: 79.1% leased and 76.0% occupied, with 31 signed residents moving in; net move-ins were 7.
occupancy.note: Leased and occupied are month-end readings on 982 units.

funnel.label: Leasing funnel
funnel.takeaway: 612 leads became 31 leases; lead to lease took 25.6 days.
funnel.note: Counts are August activity at each step, not one group of prospects followed through, and each rate compares a step with the step before it. The longest step was application to lease at 12.4 days, 48% of the cycle. Days are Hyly's step velocity; we're confirming whether that's a median or an average.

spend.label: Spend and leases
spend.takeaway: $12,400 across 4 vendors; Apartments.com had the lowest cost per lead at $45.
spend.note: Leads and leases here use each lead's first source (the vendor basis). Most paid visitors reach the property website before they inquire, so the website carries the first-touch lease credit; Where leads came from shows the paid sources' part earlier in the journey.

attribution.label: Where leads came from
attribution.takeaway: Property website was the first source for 318 of 612 new leads; 1,904 prospects were influenced across all touches.
attribution.note: First touch credits each lead to the source that brought it in. Influenced counts a prospect once for every source that touched it, so the columns add up to more than the prospect total. The Hyly assistant played a part in 58 of the 121 tours. By medium, 65.7% of new leads were organic and 15.7% were tagged paid search.

website.label: Website
website.takeaway: 11,480 sessions from 8,214 users, 53.5% engaged; floor plan B1 drew the most views per user (3.12).
website.note: Average engagement time was 48 seconds. Facebook sent 1,286 sessions with an 81.6% bounce rate and 6 conversions; we're reviewing where those visitors land. The floor plans page was viewed 7,366 times.

paid_search.label: Paid search
paid_search.takeaway: 3.22% click-through rate, within the 3–5% benchmark; we're aligning 413 ad conversions with the 96 leads in the CRM.
paid_search.note: Google Ads recorded 413 conversions, and 96 leads with Google Ads as their first source reached the CRM, with 4 leases. We're aligning the conversion definition with CRM leads before the next budget cycle.

reputation.label: Reputation
reputation.takeaway: Google 4.1 and Apartments.com 3.7; Yelp and Facebook aren't connected yet.

listings.label: Listings
listings.note: Placement tiers and costs aren't in the listing feed yet.

actions.title: Align Google Ads conversion tracking with CRM leads
actions.detail: Google Ads recorded 413 conversions, and 96 leads with Google Ads as their first source reached the CRM. We'll align the conversion definition so bidding follows real inquiries.

actions.title: Build lease-up ad variants from the existing photo library
actions.detail: 205 units were available at month end. We'll cut new crops, ad variants and short video edits from the photos and floor plans we already have, one set per floor plan, and rotate them into Google Ads and Meta.

actions.title: Improve where Facebook visitors land
actions.detail: Facebook, where our Meta ads run, sent 1,286 website sessions with an 81.6% bounce rate. We're pointing each ad at the floor plan page it shows.

actions.title: Shorten the time from application to lease
actions.detail: Application to lease took 12.4 of the 25.6 days from lead to lease. We'll review the approval steps with the leasing team.

actions.title: Respond to Apartments.com reviews
actions.detail: Apartments.com is at 3.7 on 64 reviews, below the 4.0 target. We'll draft responses to recent reviews for the community team to approve.

actions_takeaway: 5 steps for next month, starting with aligning Google Ads conversion tracking with CRM leads.

discrepancies.text: Google Ads recorded 413 conversions, while 96 leads list Google Ads as their first source; we're aligning the conversion definition.

gaps.reason: Days per step are Hyly's velocity figures; the metric library doesn't define them yet, so whether they're medians or averages is unconfirmed.
Placement tier and cost aren't in the listing feed yet. Chat, tour and application lead types aren't populated, so they're left out rather than shown as zero.
Reputation scores come from a monthly snapshot; the lake export doesn't carry them, so they aren't reconciled.

sources_note: 1–31 August 2026 · Hyly data lake (occupancy, leasing and lead sources) · Hyly data-lake dashboard export (spend manager, multi-touch attribution, website and Google Ads) · reputation scores from the monthly snapshot · RPM benchmarks
